# Samsung Electronics

> www.samsung.com is the global website of Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd., covering Galaxy mobile devices, televisions, home appliances, monitors, and memory storage products across regional markets.

This document covers www.samsung.com only    the consumer electronics web presence. Samsung's semiconductor, display, and other B2B divisions operate under separate domains listed in this file. Samsung Group affiliates (Samsung SDI, Samsung SDS, Samsung C&T, Samsung Life, etc.) are independent entities not covered here.

Each country or region has a dedicated site at www.samsung.com/{site-code}/ with local product catalogs, pricing, promotions, and customer support. For product-specific queries, refer to the relevant regional file below.

## Regional Sites

Samsung operates localized sites for over 80 countries and regions under www.samsung.com/{site-code}/. The following are the regional sites that currently provide a dedicated llms.txt guide.

- [Australia (AU)](https://www.samsung.com/au/llms.txt): Products, offers, and support for the Australian market
- [Gulf English (AE)](https://www.samsung.com/ae/llms.txt): Products, offers, and support for the UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, and Oman markets (English)
- [Gulf Arabic (AE_AR)](https://www.samsung.com/ae_ar/llms.txt): Products, offers, and support for the UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, and Oman markets (Arabic)
- [Spain (ES)](https://www.samsung.com/es/llms.txt): Products, offers, and support for the Spanish market
- [Indonesia (ID)](https://www.samsung.com/id/llms.txt): Products, offers, and support for the Indonesian market
- [Malaysia (MY)](https://www.samsung.com/my/llms.txt): Products, offers, and support for the Malaysian market
- [New Zealand (NZ)](https://www.samsung.com/nz/llms.txt): Products, offers, and support for the New Zealand market
- [Philippines (PH)](https://www.samsung.com/ph/llms.txt): Products, offers, and support for the Philippine market
- [Portugal (PT)](https://www.samsung.com/pt/llms.txt): Products, offers, and support for the Portuguese market
- [Singapore (SG)](https://www.samsung.com/sg/llms.txt): Products, offers, and support for the Singapore market
- [Thailand (TH)](https://www.samsung.com/th/llms.txt): Products, offers, and support for the Thai market
- [United Kingdom (UK)](https://www.samsung.com/uk/llms.txt): Products, offers, and support for the UK market
- [Vietnam (VN)](https://www.samsung.com/vn/llms.txt): Products, offers, and support for the Vietnamese market

## Corporate & Brand

- [Samsung Global Newsroom](https://news.samsung.com/global/): Official press releases, product launches, and corporate announcements
- [Investor Relations](https://www.samsung.com/global/ir/): Financial reports, earnings, and corporate governance
- [Sustainability](https://www.samsung.com/global/sustainability/): Environmental, social, and governance commitments
- [Corporate Social Responsibility](https://csr.samsung.com/): Community programs, education initiatives, and social impact
- [Samsung Design](https://design.samsung.com/): Product design philosophy, portfolio, and awards

## Technology & Developer

- [Galaxy AI](https://www.samsung.com/galaxy-ai/): On-device and cloud AI features across Galaxy devices
- [SmartThings](https://www.samsung.com/smartthings/): IoT platform connecting Samsung and third-party smart home devices
- [Samsung Knox](https://www.samsungknox.com/): Enterprise mobile security platform
- [One UI](https://www.samsung.com/one-ui/): Samsung's user interface for Galaxy mobile devices
- [Tizen](https://developer.samsung.com/tizen): Operating system for Samsung Smart TVs and IoT devices
- [Samsung Open Source](https://opensource.samsung.com/): Open source software and kernel source releases
- [Samsung Mobile Security](https://security.samsungmobile.com/): Security updates, patches, and vulnerability reporting

## Other Samsung Electronics Domains

- [Samsung Semiconductor](https://semiconductor.samsung.com/): Memory, System LSI, and foundry business
- [Samsung Display](https://www.samsungdisplay.com/): OLED and display panel technologies
- [Samsung Research](https://research.samsung.com/): R&D initiatives, publications, and advanced technology
- [Samsung Business Insights](https://insights.samsung.com/): Enterprise technology trends, case studies, and B2B solutions

## Optional

- [Samsung Sitemap Index](https://www.samsung.com/sitemap.xml): Top-level sitemap index linking to regional and category-specific sitemaps
- [Samsung Careers](https://www.samsung.com/careers/): Global employment opportunities

	<script type="text/javascript">
	/**
	 * [설정] 상수 및 구성
	 */
	const URL_HISTORY_KEY = 'URL_History';
	const MAX_HISTORY_COUNT = 20; // 최대 보관할 기록 개수
	
	/**
	 * 로컬 스토리지 URL 히스토리 저장 (인코딩 URL + 10자리 타임스탬프)
	 * @param {string} url - 저장할 페이지 URL
	 */
	//갯수 제한용
	function appendUrlHistoryWithTime(url) {
	    // 1. 데이터 가공: URL 인코딩 및 10자리 타임스탬프 생성
	    const encodedUrl = encodeURIComponent(url);
	    const timestamp = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000); // 13자리 밀리초를 10자리 초 단위로 변환
	    const newDataUnit = encodedUrl + '~' + timestamp; // URL과 시간을 ~로 구분하여 결합
	    
	    // 2. 기존 데이터 가져오기 및 배열로 변환
	    let existingValue = localStorage.getItem(URL_HISTORY_KEY);
	    //기존 데이터 조회
	    //console.log(`URL_HISTORY_KEY before existingValue: ` + existingValue);
	    let historyArray = [];
	    
	    if (existingValue) {
	        historyArray = existingValue.split('|'); // 기존 데이터를 배열로 분할
	    }
	    
	    // 3. 새로운 기록을 배열 끝에 추가
	    historyArray.push(newDataUnit);
	    //히스토리 사이즈 조회
	    //console.log(`URL_HISTORY_KEY historyArray.length: ` + historyArray.length); 
	    
	    // 4. FIFO 방식으로 최대 개수 제한 (오래된 것부터 제거)
	    while (historyArray.length > MAX_HISTORY_COUNT) {
	        historyArray.shift(); // 배열의 첫 번째 요소(가장 오래된 기록) 제거
	    }
	    
	    // 5. 배열을 다시 문자열로 변환하여 저장
	    const updatedValue = historyArray.join('|');
	    
	    // 6. 최종 저장 (에러 처리 포함)
	    try {
	        localStorage.setItem(URL_HISTORY_KEY, updatedValue);
	        //console.log(`[`+URL_HISTORY_KEY+`] 업데이트 완료 (길이: `+updatedValue.length+`)`);
	        //console.log(`URL_HISTORY_KEY after existingValue: ` + localStorage.getItem(URL_HISTORY_KEY));//데이터 조회
	    } catch (e) {
	        console.error("Storage Error:", e);
	        // 저장 실패 시 더 오래된 데이터를 제거하여 재시도

	function getUrlHistory() {
	    const historyData = localStorage.getItem(URL_HISTORY_KEY);
	    if (!historyData) return [];
	    
	    return historyData.split('|').map(item => {
	        const [encodedUrl, timestamp] = item.split('~');
	        return {
	            url: decodeURIComponent(encodedUrl),
	            timestamp: parseInt(timestamp, 10),
	            date: new Date(parseInt(timestamp, 10) * 1000)
	        };
	    });
	}

	} else {
	    window.addEventListener('load', () => {
	        //위 상태에서 실행되지 않은 경우에만 실행

	            executeUrlHistoryTracking();
	            hasExecutedInitialLoad = true;
	        }
	    });
	}

	let currentUrl = window.location.href;

	['popstate'].forEach(eventType => {
	    window.addEventListener(eventType, () => {
	        if (currentUrl !== window.location.href) {

	            setTimeout(executeUrlHistoryTracking, 100);
	        }
	    });
	});

	// pushState/replaceState 감지(URL이 변경될때)
	const originalPushState = history.pushState;          // 1. 기존의 원본 pushState 함수를 변수에 저장해 둡니다. (나중에 호출하기 위함)
